=== IMPLEMENTATION NOTES ===

1. tools/runner changes (4 edit sites):
   a. header docstring: WORKER-CHANNEL section extended (T370: env propagation, degraded mode warns, mid-run poll).
   b. _check_directives(task_id, repo_root, verbose=True): returns the list of pending STOP directives (pause/kill) instead of a bool; verbose=False skips printing the pending list (mid-run poll must not spam stderr with amend/question every poll). Launch-time behaviour identical (verbose=True prints full list, caller exits 124 on non-empty).
   c. identity resolution: identity_degraded flag; fallback prints 5-line WARNING (consequence: liveness cannot attribute, directives cannot reach; fix: export MANAGENT_TASK_ID or --task-id); identified runs print 'task identity: <id> (source: ...)'.
   d. mid-run directive poll: --directive-poll-s (default 10, 0 off); in the poll loop, every N s call _check_directives(verbose=False); on a stop, kill_reason = 'directive <id> <DIR> from <from> (mid-run poll)', SIGKILL group, heartbeat, exit 124 (reuses the existing kill path; kill/wall/RSS semantics untouched). Poll gated on not identity_degraded (a runner/<pid> identity can never match a directive target).

2. managent (src/managent/main.zig):
   a. ageSecFromTs(ts_str, now_unix) extracted to module level (was a closure inside cmdResume); cmdResume call sites now bind to it. Verified resume/audit still work.
   b. cmdLiveness rewrite: --stale-min <float> flag + LIVENESS_STALE_MIN env (default 5.0 min); per in_progress row: latest beat + beat count; three states: never beat since dispatch <claimed> / beating (age <= threshold) / beats stopped N (m|s) ago; keeps command/wall/cpu/rss display. Header prints '(threshold: X.X min)'.
   c. cmdClaim: both successful branches (dispatchable + blocked) print '  export MANAGENT_TASK_ID=<id>  (so tools/runner heartbeats land under this task)'.
   d. usage line for liveness updated.

3. bin/subagent + bin/ollama-subagent: --dry-run now prints MANAGENT_TASK_ID=<id> when dispatching a task (propagation visible); real dispatch already set the env.

4. Docs: docs/infra/runner.md (Identity section + --directive-poll-s row + liveness states section), docs/infra/host/runner.md (Liveness feed identity note), docs/infra/delegation/DELEGATEE.md (worker must export MANAGENT_TASK_ID after claim).

=== DEBUGGING STORY (what cost time) ===
- My first mid-run/kill manual tests showed zero progress heartbeats: the runner watches stderr only, and my test ticker printed to stdout. Runner behaviour is correct (project commands emit [progress] on stderr); fixed the test script (file=sys.stderr).
- The runner writes heartbeats via json.dumps(sort_keys=True) -> '  "task": "T370P"' with a SPACE; my greps matched the no-space seeded form. Grep pattern fixed to '"task": "T370K"'.
- Regression script first run: 'cd "$TMP" && CMD &' backgrounds a SUBSHELL, so $! was the wrapper, not the runner; kill -9 killed the wrapper and the runner survived (still beating after the interval -> control 4 FAIL). Fixed with '(cd "$TMP" && exec env ...) &' so $! IS the runner. Also fixed wait-under-set-e (capture RC with set +e) and shortened the null-control ticker (must COMPLETE normally).
- The progress-watchdog branch not firing was traced to the stdout/stderr confusion above, NOT a runner defect (verified: pre-existing at HEAD, stderr ticker fires 'progress watchdog active' and emits beats).
